slides.texte_overlay:
psychology hacks that make
people open up to you

mirror their last words

repeat the last few words someone said as a gentle question. it shows you're listening closely, and people almost always keep talking and explain more.

sit at an angle

sit beside someone or at a slight angle instead of directly opposite. face to face feels like an interview, while side by side feels relaxed and friendly.

share something first

people open up after you share something real first. an interesting story or a strange fact is the easiest and most natural place to start any conversation.
slides.texte_sophia:
share something first

i always share one interesting thing first, like a strange myth. i learn one a day in 5 minutes with the Sophia app, and people open up so much faster after i do.

slides.texte_overlay:
lower your voice

speak a little softer when the conversation turns personal. a quieter voice signals that this is a safe space, and people naturally match your calm tone.

don't rush to advise

when someone shares a problem, ask how they feel before offering solutions. feeling understood first is what makes people trust you with even more of their story.
